recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours of the mushroom caps: every cap becomes a warm tan brown (#b98a55) or a russet brown (#8a5a34) with small cream spots, with no red, no pink and no green caps anywhere. Keep the mushrooms, their cream stalks, the three strips of brown soil, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: mushroom-flux-b has the right shapes (three thin beds of six mushrooms) but red and green caps.

recipes.editInstruction: Erase only the flat slab of grass, dirt and stone under the machine, making it fully transparent. Do not change anything standing on it: the three dark blue solar panels, the chrome frame and feet and the mast with the pink light stay exactly as they are, with the same colours, outline and art style.
recipes.notes: solar-b reads at once (three big panels, the magenta mast) but stands on a grass and dirt slab.

recipes.editInstruction: Remove all ground: erase the grass, dirt and stone plate under the solar panels, so the three round grey feet stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them: no slab, no plate, no glass, no shadow. Keep the three dark blue solar panels, the frame, the feet, the mast with the pink light, the colours, outline and art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: solar-b-edit turned the grass slab into a pale glass plate instead of removing it.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours and the sail cloth of this windmill: the tower becomes dark slate-grey stone (#5a5f6b), the cone roof near-black charcoal (#2b2b31), the four sails become ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth with holes and tattered edges on dark wooden arms, and the small window glows violet (#a221ee). Nothing is red, cream or terracotta any more. Keep the windmill's shape, size, the X of four sails, the door, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: The Undead Windmill as an edit of the accepted shared Windmill, so the canvas, footprint and silhouette stay.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn each of the three raised beds of soil into a long trough of polished silver chrome metal with a soft blue-grey shade (no brown soil left), and put a small clear pale glass dome with one white highlight over every vegetable plant. Keep the green vegetable plants, the three rows, the empty transparent gaps between them, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: The Martian Farm as an edit of the accepted Farm candidate (veg-flux-a), so the beds, plants and gaps stay.
